states.purpose: require a valid quiet supported state before launch initiation
observable_inputs: RES-84 active support hull and sagittal margin

quiet_criteria.bilateral_legal_plantar_active: left and right both have at least one ACTIVE legal plantar contact

hysteresis_debounce.reset_rule: any failing sample resets the consecutive counter to zero

failure_reversion.on_support_loss: stay in STAND and restart the dwell; a support loss in STAND is never a takeoff

states.wall_clock_role: the dwell is a physical-time count of native samples; no wall-clock authority

states.purpose: initiate controlled descent using state feedback; no hard-coded ideal knee/hip depth
observable_inputs: RES-84 SYSTEM_COM z and vz (descent rate feedback)
RES-84 active support hull sagittal interval (CoP clamping)
states.entry: from STAND on the quiet-dwell predicate
states.descent_law: state feedback: the leg-flexion reference rate is driven by the measured descent-velocity error against the frozen descent-velocity command; structural joint limits are bounds on the reference, never movement targets

hysteresis_debounce.trigger: d_stop >= remaining_structural_descent_budget - margin OR measured vz <= -0.55 m/s OR flexion reference reaches the structural limit

definitions.d_stop_m: vz^2 / (2 * a_brake) with a_brake = 2.5 m/s^2 (frozen braking acceleration authority)
definitions.remaining_structural_descent_budget_m: z(SYSTEM_COM, current) - z_struct_min, where z_struct_min is the SYSTEM_COM height at the structural maximum-flexion bound computed from the sealed Plant geometry (knee at its ROM limit) at controller initialisation

hysteresis_debounce.one_way: the trigger is one-way; there is no revert to COUNTERMOVEMENT

failure_reversion.on_support_loss: enter TAKEOFF_CONFIRM provisionally if a RES-84 support-to-zero candidate exists; otherwise revert to STAND

states.wall_clock_role: none; the phase duration is determined by the measured state

states.purpose: arrest downward momentum without relying on a hard time switch
observable_inputs: RES-84 legal ground wrench and CoP validity
states.entry: from COUNTERMOVEMENT on the predictive braking trigger

hysteresis_debounce.rule: SYSTEM_COM_vz >= 0.0 at native sample k with SYSTEM_COM_vz < 0.0 at sample k-1
hysteresis_debounce.not_time: explicitly not a timer, not a stored timestamp, not a replay schedule

failure_reversion.on_support_loss: enter TAKEOFF_CONFIRM provisionally if a RES-84 support-to-zero candidate exists; otherwise revert to STAND

states.purpose: generate bounded extension under the frozen moment/rate/power authority
observable_inputs: RES-84 SYSTEM_COM z, vz and the measured leg extension
states.entry: from BRAKING on the physical upward reversal

hysteresis_debounce.rule: the RES-84 support-to-zero transition (legal_plantar_active[k-1] > 0 and legal_plantar_active[k] == 0) using the RES-84 native frame stream
hysteresis_debounce.prohibition: the diagnostic 10 N force comparator is never the takeoff authority

failure_reversion.on_support_loss_without_candidate: revert to BRAKING if vz <= 0.0 else remain in PROPULSION and re-evaluate from measured state

states.purpose: provisional flight candidate entered at physical support loss; continuity-preserving posture law; never the diagnostic comparator
observable_inputs: RES-84 native frames: legal_plantar_active, legal_plantar_detected, prohibited_detected
RES-84 SYSTEM_COM vz at the occurrence
RES-84 PHYSICAL_TIME dwell evaluation through the shared primitive
states.entry: provisionally at physical support loss (PROPULSION exit predicate)

exit_predicates.to_FLIGHT: RES-84 TAKEOFF_CONFIRMATION confirmed == true (all frozen checks pass: dwell coverage, no legal plantar recontact through the confirmation sample, bilateral clearance reaching the guard, positive SYSTEM_COM vz at the occurrence, no prohibited contact)
exit_predicates.to_supported_state: legal plantar recontact (legal_plantar_active > 0) at any native sample before confirmation
exit_predicates.to_claim_end_no_flight: horizon ends before any confirmation or recontact; the episode closes WITHOUT a flight claim and the failed checks are recorded

hysteresis_debounce.confirmation_sample: first native sample at or after occurrence_time + 0.050 s (never the last sample before the requirement)
hysteresis_debounce.prohibited: no wall-clock latch, no early allowance, no shifted occurrence timestamp

reversion_mapping.prohibited_contact: FAIL_CLOSED: controller fault; the candidate is rejected and is never shifted
reversion_mapping.candidate_rejected_by_clearance_or_vz: remain in TAKEOFF_CONFIRM monitoring without the FLIGHT latch; the RES-85 flight claim is refused

states.purpose: latched genuine flight with a posture policy continuous with terminal propulsion; no ground impulse exists after physical takeoff
states.entry: only on a valid RES-84 TAKEOFF_CONFIRMATION; monotone latch that cannot be un-entered in the same episode

hysteresis_debounce.rule: apex/descent: two consecutive native samples with SYSTEM_COM_vz <= 0 after at least one positive sample, or vz <= -0.25 m/s, or predicted touchdown z/(-vz) <= 0.05 s with vz < -0.05
hysteresis_debounce.prohibited: no stored replay timestamps, no scheduled landing time

failure_reversion.on_illegal_ground_contact: FAIL_CLOSED: prohibited or non-plantar floor contact during flight invalidates the flight claim and raises the controller fault

states.purpose: enter from the actual flight/apex/descent/predicted-touchdown state; stop the RES-85 control claim before RES-86 landing optimisation
states.entry: from FLIGHT on the apex/descent predicate
states.exit_predicate: first legal plantar recontact (touchdown) -> RES-85 claim ends

hysteresis_debounce.rule: legal_plantar_active > 0 at a native sample while in LANDING_PREP

states.scope_limit: no landing capture optimisation, no recovery work; the controller holds a declared landing-prep posture within the RES-85 actuation authority only

no_scorer_private_memory.rule: the phase machine may use only the current and previous RES-84 native frames, the RES-84 event primitives and its own phase/debounce counters; it may not read scorer internals, trajectories, replay arrays, oracle outputs or stored timestamps

wall_clock_prohibition.statement: Wall-clock time may implement minimum dwell/debounce only. It may not be the primary FLEX->EXTEND, reversal, takeoff or flight authority.
wall_clock_prohibition.frozen_prohibition: no time-programmed or schedule-replay primary transition exists in any state definition above

duplicated_event_definitions.rule: the controller contains no second definition of contact truth, support classification, SYSTEM_COM, takeoff occurrence, takeoff confirmation, force comparator, PHYSICAL_TIME dwell, clearance or CoP/support hull: those are consumed from loaded_cmj.v3.measurement
duplicated_event_definitions.prohibition: no local re-implementation, no parallel threshold

fail_closed.rule: an invalid controller state or malformed observation raises/returns an explicit failure state
fail_closed.forbidden: broad exception swallowing and silent zero actions

mandatory_negative_controls_supported_by: one native-sample support dropout cannot permanently enter FLIGHT
five true diagnostic-comparator samples at 500 Hz reject; six true samples confirm the diagnostic comparator only (never FLIGHT)
support loss followed by recontact before 50 ms rejects confirmation
one foot still supported cannot be physical takeoff
zero support with insufficient clearance cannot confirm flight
nonpositive SYSTEM_COM_vz at the occurrence rejects
